d: A crucial leadership role that reports to his line Manager with the day-to-day fieldwork team. As the primary onsite leader at the client's office, you will manage the daily operations of the audit, guide the junior team, and serve as the main point of contact for the client’s finance department. You will manage multiple audit projects from the planning phase all the way through to the final audit report in accordance with International Standards and BDO Audit Methodology.

5 - 6 years of Post Qualification Experience including time spent as a Senior auditor or Acting Assistant Manager at a large international accounting firm; Proven ability to manage, organize, and motivate a team physically onsite; Strong communication skills with the ability to handle difficult conversations; Strong understanding of IFRS and ISA (knowledge of AOIFI, Commercial Companies Law and other relevant regulations would be an advantage) and Well versed with various accounting software and applications used by different industry sectors.
